hook.line: I'm going to put you onto the absolute most low-hanging fruit in SEO right now.
hook.visual: Tight selfie close-up, wide eyes and open mouth, hands clasped; sparkling 'PAM ANN MARKETING' wordmark at top, white phrase captions mid-frame

beats.what: Promise of the easiest, lowest-effort SEO win
Jump cut to the reveal: keywords you rank for that show an AI Overview you're not in
Jump cut to credibility: the reports her agency builds for clients
Why it works: Google already ranks the page, so it is close to citing it
Cut to a new setting (brick wall) for the how-to part: 'what do I mean by reverse engineering?'
Step 1: paste the keyword into gemini.google.com
Step 2: click 'double check this response'; explains LLMs answer first, then look for sources
Payoff: the unsourced tidbit is your opportunity
Ends on 'cited in the AI overview going forward', no CTA

why_it_works: 'Low-hanging fruit' promise sets a low-effort payoff, so the viewer stays for a trick they can use today
Gives a step-by-step method with a specific button ('double check this response'), which makes it save-worthy (26 shares)
Animated hand gestures and direct eye contact carry energy through a long single-location talk
weaknesses: 142 s with no screen recording of Gemini or the double-check button; the demo is only described
The reveal is delayed to ~12 s after a definition of 'low hanging fruit'
No CTA despite a strong save-worthy method
for_robert: Use the 'easiest win right now' promise, then actually show the tool step on screen; Fred can tap the exact button she only names.
